svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walls: 2 mm sheet, 700 x 600 outside (the firebox size), 170 tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open at the bottom. Top: 2 mm plate welded on, 150 hole in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom frame: 25 x 25 x 3 angle round the outside, horizontal leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outward, with 14 holes 9 mm matching the roof bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld twelve M8 studs on the top plate for the economizer base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail slot: in the right end, 152 in front of the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 wide, from the bottom edge up to 113: the box lowers over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bank tails. A 3 mm cover with two 16.5 holes closes it (2 x M5).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Line the walls with 25 mm blanket and pin 25 mm board under the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on a rope gasket on the roof; the 14 roof bolts clamp it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bank tails slide in the cover holes; no light shows.
